from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Start date
start_date = datetime(2025, 6, 1)

# Holidays (not business days)
holidays = {
    datetime(2025, 7, 22).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 2).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 4).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 10).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 24).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 29).date(),
    datetime(2025, 10, 1).date(),
    datetime(2025, 10, 20).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 7).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 10).date(),
    datetime(2025, 12, 15).date(),
}

# Count business days
business_days_count = 0
current_date = start_date

while True:
    # Check if current date is a business day
    # Monday=0, Tuesday=1, ..., Friday=4, Saturday=5, Sunday=6
    if current_date.weekday() < 5 and current_date.date() not in holidays:
        business_days_count += 1
        if business_days_count == 59:
            break
    
    current_date += timedelta(days=1)

print(f"ANSWER: {current_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
